records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.EmbeddingsScreen.closeEvent#1
records.source: Crop loading and classifier training are asked to stop first; further training progress is ignored. Each ``shutdown`` waits a bounded time, then parks any worker that outlasts it. A parked training worker can finish writing its checkpoint without updating this closed GUI view; it is not forcibly terminated.
records.context: Extracted image region loading and machine-learning classification model training are asked to stop first; further training progress is ignored. Each ``shutdown`` waits a bounded time, then parks any worker that outlasts it. A parked training worker can finish writing its checkpoint without updating this closed GUI view; it is not forcibly terminated.
records.translation: L’arrêt du chargement des extraits et de l’entraînement du classificateur est demandé en premier ; toute progression ultérieure de l’entraînement est ignorée. Chaque ``shutdown`` attend un temps limité, puis met à l’écart tout thread de travail encore actif. Un thread d’entraînement ainsi mis à l’écart peut terminer l’écriture de son point de contrôle sans mettre à jour cette vue GUI fermée ; il n’est pas arrêté de force.
records.review_basis: Exact-source technical translation authoring with separate coordinator semantic review. Raw crop/channel/label-group contracts, worker cancellation/lifecycle and protected literals retained; normal source/context and actual inline markup gates passed. No native-speaker claim.
